thread.old_title: The gathering of the scattered twelve tribes — Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36, 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13, and Tobit 13 (FRAMEWORK-MAJOR)
thread.title: The gathering of the scattered twelve tribes — Sirach 36, 2 Esdras 13 and Tobit 13 behind *I am not sent but unto the lost sheep*
thread.old_summary: Matt 15:24's *I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel)* — the King's-own-mission-scope statement, paired with the Matt 10:5-6's apostolic-mission-scope, reading as the load-bearing scripture-anchor for the framework's gathering-of-the-scattered-twelve-tribes thesis — read against the wisdom-stream's direct articulation of the gathering-of-the-scattered-tribes prayer-and-prophecy substance. Five moves: Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 36:1 names the petition — *have mercy upon us, O Yahuah (God) of all, and behold us* (the wisdom-stream's-prayer-for-the-gathering); Sirach 36:11 names THE direct verbal-anchor — *gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning* (the explicit wisdom-stream-articulation of the twelve-tribes-restoration the prophets had named at Yechezk'el (Ezekiel) 37:21; Yirmeyahu (Jeremiah) 31:8-10; Hosea 1:10-11; Zekharyah (Zechariah) 10:6-10); 2 Esdras (4 Ezra) 13:40 names the ten-tribes-carried-away — *those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive* (the wisdom-stream's-direct-articulation of the Assyrian-exile-architecture the lost-sheep-mission-scope addresses); 2 Esdras 13:48 names the remnant-within-the-borders — *but those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders* (the wisdom-stream's naming of both registers the King's-mission addresses); Tobit 13:5 names the scourge-then-mercy-then-gathering-out-of-all-nations — *he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us* (the operative-architecture the King's-mission enacts). The framework reads the cluster as FRAMEWORK-MAJOR for the lost-sheep-mission-scope's wisdom-stream corroboration. The Pharisaic-system had built credentialing-systems on top of the binary (Yahudah (Judah) and the nations, no scattered-twelve-tribes coming-home); the wisdom-stream had preserved the architecture the prophets had named. The King's-mission at v.24 IS the operative-form of the wisdom-stream's-prayer at Sirach 36:11; the lost-sheep-of-the-house-of-Yashar'el (Israel) the King is sent-to IS the all-the-tribes-of-Ya'aqov (Jacob) the wisdom-stream had prayed for the gathering of. The framework reads the Canaanite-woman's mercy-at-the-crumbs-substance (vv.25-28) within the architecture — as the master's-table-mercy-to-the-categorical-nations-individual that does NOT collapse the seed-distinction (Red Line #7) but operates within it.
thread.summary:
It ain't new. He said who he was sent to in one sentence:

*But he answered and said, I am not sent but unto the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 15:24)

He had sent the twelve the same way: *But go rather to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Matthew 10:6). Who was lost? Not Yahudah (Judah) in Jerusalem, who could be found any Sabbath. The books the Reformation cut from the library say plainly who:

*Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land in the time of Osea the king, whom Salmanasar the king of Assyria led away captive, and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.* (2 Esdras 13:40)

*But those that be left behind of your people are they that are found within my borders.* (2 Esdras 13:48)

Two groups: the ten tribes beyond the waters, and the remnant inside the borders. Tobit, himself of Naphtali in that captivity, says what comes after the scattering:

*And he will scourge us for our iniquities, and will have mercy again, and will gather us out of all nations, among whom he has scattered us.* (Tobit 13:5)

And Sirach prays for it:

*Have mercy upon us, O Yahuah (God) of all, and behold us:* (Sirach 36:1)

*Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning.* (Sirach 36:11)

The prophets had said it before them, *I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side* (Ezekiel 37:21), and Moses before the prophets: *will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath scattered thee.* (Deuteronomy 30:3). So when he says he was sent to the lost sheep of the house of Yashar'el (Israel), the prayer of Sirach 36:11 is being answered in person, and Paul says as much: *a minister of the circumcision for the truth of Elohim (God), to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:* (Romans 15:8). After he rose the sending went *to all nations* (Matthew 28:19), because that is where the sheep are, *until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.* (Romans 11:25). The woman of Canaan in this same passage, in the coasts of Tyre and Sidon where Elijah's widow had lived, is not an exception to his sentence. She heard, she called him Son of David, and he said *O woman, great is thy faith: be it unto thee even as thou wilt.* (Matthew 15:28). A sheep heard his voice where the house had been scattered. Anyone who holds that there is only Yahudah (Judah) and everybody else, with no ten tribes to be found, has to read every one of these books as if they were never written.
